title: Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional!
description:
Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional

Estagiário de Design Gráfico - Criação de Mídias Digitais

Atenção: Esta é uma vaga de estágio.

Interessados, por favor, leiam até o final para verificar os requisitos necessários para a vaga.

Requisito Obrigatório: Para que o candidato seja considerado para a vaga de estágio, é imprescindível que entre em contato com sua instituição de ensino, manifeste interesse pelo estágio e solicite a eles o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio. Este documento é obrigatório para a efetivação da contratação. Sem o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio, não será possível concluir o processo de seleção e iniciar o estágio.

Horário de trabalho: 10h às 17h

Salário: R$ 800 + vale alimentação de R$ 29 por dia. Totalizando uma média de salário de R$ 1.380.

Informações adicionais: A posição é remota, de segunda a sexta-feira.

É requisito obrigatório estar cursando o 3º ano da faculdade de Comunicação e Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas relacionadas.

Você é uma pessoa disponível, responsável, proativa, criativa, organizada e cheia de vontade de aprender?

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Principais responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de arte para diversas mídias digitais, tais como Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, e-mail marketing, folders, cartões de visita, entre outros.
  • Será proporcionado treinamento e acompanhamento por um profissional experiente para garantir um desenvolvimento eficaz.
  • É fundamental possuir internet de alta velocidade no local de trabalho, além de pró-atividade, bom humor, apetite por desafios e disposição para aprender.
  • Auxiliar na criação de layouts para posts em todas as plataformas digitais.
  • Edição de vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok.
  • Criação de peças digitais com direcionamento do superior.
  • Desenvolvimento de conteúdo criativo para posts de Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok.
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas.
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas.

Perfil Desejado

  • Cursar graduação em Marketing, Design gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas relacionadas é obrigatório.
  • Bom conhecimento de português, habilidades de redação e interpretação de texto.
  • Conhecimento básico em marketing digital.
  • Entendimento de Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram.
  • Muita responsabilidade, organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar várias tarefas simultaneamente.
  • Responsabilidade e capacidade de se auto-gerenciar, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e metas estabelecidos.
  • Conhecimento básico em edição de imagem e vídeo, com bom senso estético.
  • Boa comunicação para trabalho em equipe.
  • Familiaridade com programas de edição como Photoshop, Canva, Corel.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de monitoramento de desempenho será valorizada.

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte de nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação com o assunto: Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome. Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, acrescente exemplos de artes que você já tenha produzido e destaque o seu potencial para crescer como um membro valioso de nossa equipe.

Estamos ansiosos para receber sua candidatura e ajudá-lo a desenvolver suas habilidades em Design Gráfico.

Sobre Nós

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos vasta experiência e excelência nos serviços que oferecemos. Trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão e buscamos pessoas que gostem de trabalhar, tenham interesse em comunicação, sejam criativas e não tenham medo de enfrentar novos desafios. Valorizamos profissionais éticos e responsáveis, dispostos a somar ao nosso time. Acreditamos na importância da diversidade e inclusão e encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias, representando a pluralidade do nosso país. Acreditamos que uma equipe formada por indivíduos diversos nos torna mais criativos e inovadores.

title: Growth & Partnerships Specialist
description:
Overview

Growth and Partnerships Specialist (Brazil) – Job Description

Overview: Delivery Associates (DA) is seeking a strategic and highly organized Growth and Partnerships Specialist to strengthen how we pursue, position ourselves, and secure new opportunities across our global portfolio that deliver real-world public impact. Sitting at the center of our business development and strategy implementation efforts, this role combines direct support to senior leadership with ownership of systems, materials, and coordination to ensure we bring the right mix of tools, people, and ideas to each opportunity.

About Delivery Associates (DA): Delivery Associates (DA) is a global social impact consultancy specializing in transforming the public sector. With over a decade of experience and a foundation in Deliverology, DA guides leaders through every phase of implementation—delivery-oriented strategy formulation, execution, and evaluation. DA partners with governments, philanthropies, and international organizations, employing actionable strategies to achieve sustainable, lasting outcomes. In every one of our services you will find a throughline back to this focus on helping our partners to deliver better results through better implementation. We are a small but global remote organization focused on scaling impact around the world.

We believe our work is only possible through a commitment to honouring and centering a diverse range of people, experiences, and ideas, and fostering an environment that is inclusive, equitable, and empowering. A diverse team of individuals that can bring their whole self to work will perform better, help us to be stronger partners, and allow us to drive more equitable impact for people around the world.

Job Description

We are currently seeking a strategic operator, exceptional project manager, and sharp communicator to join our growing Growth Team. The Growth Team empowers our colleagues at DA to pursue high-impact work by leading our growth strategy and strengthening the tools, processes, and coordination that drive our business development efforts.

As a Growth and Partnerships Specialist, you will provide direct support to senior consulting leaders, helping prepare for external engagements, and follow through on key initiatives. You’ll also lead work to strengthen our business development infrastructure—from improving materials and supporting new partnership opportunities, to upgrading the systems and processes that underpin our pipeline. This is a dynamic role for someone who brings structure, clarity, and creativity to cross-functional work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide direct support to senior leaders , including preparation, coordination, and follow-through on new business opportunities and priorities
  • Lead the development and maintenance of core business development materials such as pitch decks, case studies, and proposal templates, keeping content sharp, current, and aligned to DA’s positioning
  • Conduct prospect and stakeholder research to inform positioning, brief senior leaders, and shape outreach and proposals
  • Draft and tailor client-facing materials , including follow ups, DA introductions and concept notes, in collaboration with senior leaders and technical teams
  • Coordinate across internal teams to bring together the right mix of expertise and experience for each opportunity
  • Support follow-through on high-priority pipeline opportunities by tracking actions, supporting internal alignment, and managing timelines
  • Maintain and improve the use of DA’s CRM , including data accuracy, insight generation, reporting, and supporting adoption across the team
  • Contribute to the improvement of business development systems and tools, including automation, bot upgrades, and process design

Core Competencies

We work well with people who demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Expert Stakeholder Management : Able to manage business development timelines, meetings, and processes across multiple stakeholders and time zones with clarity and foresight.
  • Exceptional Organization & Attention to Detail : Brings order to fast-moving workstreams and ensures materials, trackers, and data are accurate, clear, and high quality.
  • Advanced Communication & Listening : Prepares compelling, professional slides and communicates clearly with internal and external partners.
  • Proactive Ownership & Problem-Solving : Anticipates needs, flags risks, and takes initiative to keep complex BD efforts moving forward.
  • Collaboration & Teamwork : Works effectively across teams and levels, bringing a service-oriented mindset and an interest in continuous learning.

Mindsets

We work closely in diverse, global teams, leaning on each other’s strengths. We don’t expect anyone to do all these things perfectly. Our teams are made up of people who are:

  • Adaptable: Able to thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Accountable: Self-sufficient and reliable in a remote work setting.
  • Driven: Committed to delivering high-impact work.
  • Curious: Eager to learn from clients, colleagues, vendors, and partners.
  • Collaborative: Team players who value diverse perspectives.
  • Inclusive: Embrace all voices and backgrounds to enrich our work.

Required Skills/Experiences

  • Educational background: Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Business, International Relations, Communications, or a related field. Requisite years of professional experience and/or apprenticeship pathways will also be considered in lieu of formal education.
  • Professional experience: 4–6 years in consulting, business development, fundraising, communications, or partnerships in the public or philanthropic sector.
  • Technical proficiency: Strong proficiency with MS365 Workspace, slide design and creation of external-facing content; experience with CRM tools (HubSpot) preferred.
  • Communication skills: Excellent verbal and written communication abilities in English, with demonstrated experience developing external-facing content.
  • Project management: Proven ability to manage multiple opportunities.
  • Authorization + location requirements: Must have the right to work in your base location. Preference for candidates from Latin America, in particular Brazil.

What We Offer

  • Impactful work: Opportunities to engage with senior leaders and work on transformative projects.
  • Excellent colleagues: We strive to be as talent-dense and diverse as possible, so we are always learning from each other.
  • Growth environment: Everyone’s career pathway is unique—be part of a growing organization committed to continuous improvement.
  • Flexibility: Remote working environment with opportunities for global collaboration.
  • Healthy compensation: Our colleagues enjoy a comprehensive benefits package for the effort they put in.

Our Values

These values serve as an anchor, enabling us to stay true to who we are and what we stand for.

  • Passion: It is all about impact.
  • Excellence: Delivering to the highest standards.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Business Analyst | Foco em Dados - Remote - English Advanced role at Capco .

Sobre a Capco

A Capco é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e gestão especializada na transformação digital, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e orientadas por dados para um portfólio crescente de mais de 100 clientes globais, entre eles bancos, pagamentos, mercados de capitais, gestão de patrimônio e ativos, seguros e setor de energia.

Nos destacamos pela abordagem personalizada, focada na construção de parcerias estratégicas de longo prazo e na aceleração de iniciativas digitais. Nossa expertise ganha vida por meio dos Innovation Labs e da cultura premiada Be Yourself At Work , que valoriza a diversidade e o talento.

Com presença global nos principais centros financeiros — temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico — estamos comprometidos em oferecer soluções práticas e integradas, promovendo colaboração e confiança em cada projeto. Se criatividade e inovação são sua paixão, a Capco é ideal para você. Vamos te apoiar e ajudar a acelerar sua carreira!

Sobre a Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Consultant com experiência sólida em Business Analysis com plataformas de Big Data e vivência em ambientes de Cloud . Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais técnicos que desejam atuar em projetos de alto impacto, com foco em soluções escaláveis, processamento de grandes volumes de dados e modernização de ambientes analíticos.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Experiência com Data Lake, Delta Lake e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Certificações em Cloud (ex: AWS Certified Data Analytics, Azure Data Engineer, etc.).

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de orquestração como Airflow, Apache Nifi, DBT ou similares.

Juntar-se à Capco significa ingressar em uma organização comprometida com um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo onde você é incentivado a #BeYourselfAtWork (Ser Você Mesmo no Trabalho). Acreditamos que todos trazem algo diferente, por isso adoraríamos saber o que o torna diferente!

O(a) profissional ideal terá experiência em ambientes de Big Data, conhecimento em ferramentas como Snowflake e Hadoop , e facilidade em interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar, mapear e analisar requisitos de negócio voltados a dados e analytics;
  • Traduzir necessidades das áreas de negócio em histórias de usuário e requisitos técnicos claros;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times de engenharia de dados, ciência de dados e produto;
  • Realizar análises exploratórias de dados e gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Documentar processos, fluxos de dados e regras de negócio;
  • Apoiar o desenho de soluções de dados com foco em escalabilidade e performance;
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade das entregas de dados (requisitos, relatórios, dashboards, etc.).

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como Business Analyst ou Product Analyst em projetos de dados;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de Data Warehouse e Data Lake;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Snowflake, Hadoop, Hive, Spark, etc.;
  • Experiência com análise de dados utilizando SQL avançado;
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de pipelines de dados;
  • Habilidade de comunicação com perfis técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Inglês avançado.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker);
  • Noções de modelagem de dados (dimensional, relacional, etc.);
  • Experiência em ambientes Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Experiência em projetos de governança de dados ou compliance (LGPD, GDPR).

Próximos Passos

O objetivo da Capco é conduzir um processo flexível e alinhado às necessidades de cada oportunidade e talento.

  • Etapa 1: Entrevista comportamental.
  • Etapa 2: Entrevista técnica.

As etapas do nosso processo seletivo descritas são essenciais para garantir uma avaliação completa e assertiva. Contudo, elas podem ser ajustadas dependendo da senioridade do(a) candidato(a), da área de atuação e do formato do projeto.

title: Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu
description:
Join to apply for the Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Lead Linux Kernel Engineer - Ubuntu role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
The Canonical Kernel Team is seeking exceptionally talented technology experts and industry veterans with a proven track record in operating systems kernel development or low level system engineering to take the lead in the architecture, implementation, and ongoing delivery of the following (but not limited to) aspects of the Ubuntu Linux kernel:

  • Driving engagements for key Silicon and Cloud partners to provide optimal solutions for their platforms
  • Leading the mitigation of common vulnerabilities and exposures for Ubuntu Linux as well as driving active hardening in the kernel
  • Architecting enhancements to performance and correctness to make Ubuntu Linux the most reliable and highest performing Linux kernel available today
  • Streamlining the packaging and distribution of particularly troublesome third-party components for optimal experience by end users
  • Developing new means to deliver Ubuntu Linux at scale to the strict quality standards and delivery schedules expected by end users
While not a formal managerial role, the successful candidate will possess strong people skills and natural ability to lead engineers within the team, as well as working with other external teams to coordinate adoption and delivery.
We are looking for individuals with not only an incredibly deep technical background in operating system kernels and distributions, but also a strong flair for leadership and taking initiative to drive ideas and the associated delivery teams to completion.
While we hesitate to put a specific number of years of experience as a requirement for an applicant as that does not take into account relative ability or circumstances, for a comparative guideline we would be seeking candidates with the demonstrated technical equivalent of 15+ years of industry experience.
Location: We have home-based lead kernel engineer roles in every timezone, although the individual aspects as listed above may be linked to a specific geographic region.
What the role entails
  • Set the technical direction and lead the delivery of a team of junior and mid-career engineers for a key aspect of Ubuntu Linux
  • Work closely with management within and outside the team to track and coordinate initiatives to delivery
  • Collaborate daily with other senior technical leadership on the Kernel Team on how best to ensure Ubuntu stays at the pinnacle of Linux distributions
What we are looking for in you
  • Well-organised and motivated self-starter able to thrive in a remote work environment
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal
  • Expert understanding of the C programming language
  • Demonstrated expertise working in a *nix-based operating system kernel and distribution. While direct Linux experience would be ideal, it is not required.
  • Python and Bash scripting ability
  • Powerful grasp of the capabilities and nuances of the git version control system
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Ability to travel internationally at least twice a year for company events of up to two weeks length
Nice-to-have skills
  • Strong background in RTOS and real-time performance analysis
  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience with Rust, ideally as it pertains to the Linux kernel
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Overview

Company Description

Highlights of this position:

  • Location: Remote – Brazil (must be located in Brazil)
  • Mandatory: English Fluency, Team Leadership, Delphi, Oracle and Agile/Scrum.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company with 61,000+ employees, approximately 1000 laboratories across 61 countries, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.

Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

The Team

Eurofins endeavours to develop all of our software applications in-house to service and support our numerous laboratories globally. With hundreds of thousands of clinical diagnostic tests performed every day, the laboratories of the Eurofins clinical diagnostic services business line strive to ensure that every patient, wherever he or she lives, has access to the most specialized and most innovative techniques for diagnosis, monitoring and therapeutic decisions. Such activities require extensive planning and organisation which can be augmented by the use of technology.

Our Clinical LIMS Europe Program will extensively be used as the central Laboratory Information Management System throughout Europe, this role is crucial in defining and delivering the product roadmap.

Job Description

In the role, you will work with a dedicated, enthusiastic team developing enhancements to a Laboratory Information Management System (a LIMS) and supporting the LIMS' multiple customers.

Where will you be based and what business will you support?

Brazil

Responsibilities

  • Lead Development teams in a local line management capacity reporting to the Software Engineering Manager in Europe
  • Set targets and mentor the team/s locally
  • Ensure quality in team development
  • Participate in sprint planning and sprint retrospective meetings
  • Assign and deliver development tasks requested during sprint planning
  • Estimate the complexity and the workload
  • Choose the most appropriate technical solution to meet the user requirements
  • Design, develop and deploy changes to the LIMS according to the customers’ and business users’ requirements
  • Support the LIMS in collaboration with the other team members
  • Working together with other team members (Engineers/QA) to ensure high quality of delivered solutions
  • Ensuring good practices and high quality standards are implemented and followed

Experience & Qualifications

Experience

Are you our kind of extraordinary?

  • Experience as a Tech Lead in a local line management capacity
  • 4+ years of experience developing solutions using Embarcadero Delphi 2006 or later (Delphi 12 preferable)
  • Experience with using Delphi to develop Windows Services and/or UI Forms would be a clear bonus
  • 7+ years for senior roles of Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong working knowledge on server-side development with Delphi and/or with Oracle PL/SQL
  • Strong analytical, problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Good understanding of relational databases (Oracle 9i, 11c or later)
  • Strong knowledge of Agile software development practices, particularly Scrum and/or Kanban
  • Clear experience in collaboration with Business Analysts and Software Architect(s)
  • Some Experience in test driven development and test automation
  • Comfortable in unit testing and mocking with Delphi
  • Ability to translate functional requirements into technical solutions

Education

  • Bachelor\'s or master\'s degree in computer Science or similar;

What else should I know?

As the role and Eurofins\' IT Talent Acquisition team are international, please ensure to submit your application in English.

Working hours

Monday to Friday - 8:00 to 17:00

Additional Information

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 61,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of ca. 900 laboratories in 61 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.7 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional!

Estagiário de Design Gráfico - Criação de Mídias Digitais. Atenção: Esta é uma vaga de estágio. Interessados, leia até o final para verificar os requisitos necessários.

Visão Geral

Join to apply for the Estagiário De Designer Gráfico - Oportunidade De Crescimento Profissional! role at CB Marketing Boutique.

Requisitos

  • Requisito obrigatório: é indispensável que o candidato entre em contato com sua instituição de ensino, manifeste interesse pelo estágio e solicite o Termo de Compromisso de Estágio. Sem esse documento não é possível concluir o processo de seleção e iniciar o estágio.
  • É obrigatório estar cursando o 3º ano da faculdade de Comunicação e Marketing, Design Gráfico ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Conhecimentos: bom português, habilidades de redação e interpretação de texto; conhecimento básico em marketing digital; entendimento de Pacotes Office, Facebook e Instagram; edição de imagem e vídeo com bom senso estético; familiaridade com Photoshop, Canva, Corel.
  • É fundamental possuir internet de alta velocidade no local de trabalho, além de pró-atividade, bom humor, apetite por desafios e disposição para aprender.
  • Perfil desejado também inclui ser responsável, organizado, criativo, pró-ativo e com vontade de aprender.

Salário e Benefícios

  • Horário de trabalho: 10h às 17h
  • Salário: R$ 800 + vale alimentação de R$ 29 por dia. Totalizando uma média de aproximadamente R$ 1.380
  • A posição é remota, de segunda a sexta-feira.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Auxiliar na criação de layouts para posts em todas as plataformas digitais.
  • Edição de vídeos para reels, timeline, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook e TikTok.
  • Criação de peças digitais com direcionamento do superior.
  • Desenvolvimento de conteúdo criativo para posts de Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest e TikTok.
  • Agendamento de posts em todas as plataformas.
  • Criação e envio de e-mail marketing.
  • Auxiliar em tarefas diversas.

Como Se Candidatar

Se você é apaixonado pelo mundo do marketing digital, está disposto a aprender e deseja fazer parte de nossa equipe, envie seu currículo e uma breve carta de apresentação para o assunto: Estagiário de Criação - Seu Nome. Destaque seu interesse pela vaga, inclua exemplos de artes que já tenha produzido e demonstre seu potencial para crescer como membro valioso da equipe.

Sobre a CB Marketing Boutique

Somos uma agência de marketing digital totalmente online, com atendimento voltado para nichos específicos de mercado. Possuímos vasta experiência e excelência nos serviços que oferecemos. Valorizamos profissionais éticos e responsáveis, com interesse em comunicação, criatividade e disposição para enfrentar novos desafios. Valorizamos diversidade e inclusão e encorajamos candidaturas de pessoas com diferentes histórias.

title: 2D Graphic and Motion Designer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the 2D Graphic and Motion Designer role at Ruby Labs .

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at:

About The Role

We are looking for a designer skilled in both 2D static graphics (banner ads) and motion graphics (classic video editing and graphical animation) to join our performance marketing team. This role is essential to our marketing (UA) team and requires collaboration on a variety of creative projects, contributing to advertising campaigns across different platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create 2D banner and motion ads for products on platforms like Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.
  • Stay up to date with Instagram and TikTok trends, with a strong sense of timing, spacing, and dynamics in video content.
  • Generate images using AI tools.
  • Participate in creative marketing team meetings and propose your own ideas.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a 2D Graphic and Motion Designer.
  • Proficiency in Adobe software (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Strong skills in both static graphics and motion design.
  • Basic knowledge of color theory, composition, and typography.
  • For video content, a solid understanding of timing, spacing, and animation dynamics.
  • Experience with AI image generators (understanding how to formulate prompts for optimal results).
  • Creativity and ability to generate and develop new ideas.
  • English language proficiency at B2 level.
  • Portfolio with 2D banners and motion works required.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge and understanding of TikTok trends.
  • Keeping up with updates in the AI industry.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
  • Take Home Assignment
  • First Interview (60 minutes)
  • Final Interview (45 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we are a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status.

title: Software Maintenance Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Product Designer Sênior com foco em Design System | Whirlpool (Remota)

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa Product Designer Sênior com especialização em Design System, forte domínio em UI Design e Figma avançado. A posição é 100% remota e exige inglês fluente, com foco em criação, manutenção e governança de bibliotecas de componentes escaláveis, integração com desenvolvimento e documentação clara via ferramentas como o ZeroHeight.

Aptidões Necessárias

  • Design System: Construção, manutenção e escalabilidade de bibliotecas de componentes reutilizáveis, com foco em consistência visual e performance.
  • Documentação: Criação e manutenção de guias claros e acessíveis para equipes técnicas e de design.
  • Versionamento e Integração com Tech: Gestão do ciclo de vida dos componentes e alinhamento com desenvolvimento para implementação correta.
  • UI Design: Liderança em design visual responsivo, com foco em hierarquia, tipografia, microinterações e acessibilidade.
  • Validação e Testes de Interface: Realização de testes de consistência visual e experiência, garantindo qualidade da entrega.
  • Figma (avançado): Domínio de features como variables, tokens, components, auto layout, branching, slots e booleans.
  • Inglês fluente: Comunicação verbal e escrita para apresentações, reuniões com stakeholders e ambientes internacionais.
  • Comunicação e Proatividade: Clareza para defender decisões de design e autonomia para estruturar processos e colaborar com múltiplos times.

Aptidões Desejáveis

  • ZeroHeight: Conhecimento em estruturação e documentação colaborativa de Design System na plataforma.
  • Design Centrado no Usuário (UCD): Aplicação de princípios de UCD na definição de componentes escaláveis e acessíveis.
  • Interações Avançadas: Criação de interações visuais complexas que enriquecem a experiência do usuário.

Vivências Necessárias

  • Experiência consolidada em Design System: criação e evolução de bibliotecas aplicadas em múltiplos produtos.
  • Gestão de fluxos e processos: organização de entregas, alinhamento com times multidisciplinares e governança visual.
  • UI Design com foco em consistência e adaptabilidade: atuação em projetos visuais robustos e responsivos.
  • Colaboração com engenharia: integração eficiente com tech para garantir handoff, QA e entrega com fidelidade.

Vivências Desejáveis

  • Uso prático do ZeroHeight para documentação e governança de Design System.
  • Participação em contextos internacionais, com apresentações e decisões conduzidas em inglês.
  • Experiência com testes de qualidade visual (QA) para garantir alinhamento entre design e entrega final.

Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. Gympass is now Wellhub, with a refreshed identity, an expanded network of wellbeing partners, and an improved app experience.

We are hiring a Partner Success Executive to our Partner Success team in Minas Gerais !

Your Impact

  • Build long term relationships with our existing fitness partners, including multiple stakeholders but focusing on decision makers;
  • Map and negotiate with new and current partners;
  • Plan, monitor and control relevant results and key figures in order to maximize our business;

Overview

Quality Assurance Integrações (Partner Engineer). Se você se considera um profissional talentoso em testar e homologar integrações, criar materiais para compartilhar conhecimento e tem interesse em atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, próximo de parceiros e com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de clientes, essa é a sua chance! Como trabalhamos: Nossa essência é o Trust. Trabalhamos com foco, ritmo, comunicação clara e dados para nos apoiar. Trabalhamos com capricho; colocamos cuidado e qualidade em tudo que fazemos. Empatia e respeito são pilares da nossa equipe.

Sobre a Clicksign

Somos uma empresa brasileira líder em assinaturas eletrônicas. Em essência, facilitamos relações entre pessoas e empresas no ambiente digital. Por trás da nossa tecnologia de ponta e foco em segurança, temos a missão de fazer o mundo crescer, tornando as relações digitais cada vez mais inteligentes.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Analista de QA – Integrações , com paixão e experiência em garantir qualidade e experiência do usuário em integrações entre sistemas. Se você se considera um profissional talentoso em testar e homologar integrações, criar materiais para compartilhar conhecimento e tem interesse em atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, próximo de parceiros e com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de clientes, essa é a sua chance! Você fará parte do time responsável por assegurar a qualidade das integrações entre parceiros e Clicksign, atuando de forma colaborativa e remota.

Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar estratégias de testes para a Value Stream de Integrações, garantindo que as integrações sejam valiosas para os clientes e seguras.
  • Executar e manter casos de teste abrangentes (happy path e cenários de exceção), assegurando aderência a padrões de qualidade e LGPD.
  • Coordenar a homologação final das integrações, coletando evidências de experiência do usuário para melhoria contínua.

Comunicação e Alinhamento

  • Apoiar a produção de materiais explicativos e tutoriais que facilitem a adoção das integrações por clientes e parceiros.
  • Organizar e conduzir treinamentos técnicos, apresentando resultados para áreas internas e reforçando a disseminação de conhecimento.

Projetos de Integração

  • Participar ativamente de projetos de integração e homologação de APIs, garantindo qualidade ponta a ponta desde o discovery até o lançamento.
  • Colaborar com Engenharia, Produto e Jurídico para antecipar falhas e propor soluções alinhadas às necessidades do cliente.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência

  • 2+ anos em QA/Testing, preferencialmente em produtos web/SaaS.
  • Vivência com testes de integrações ou APIs.

Qualificações técnicas

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de teste de API (Postman).
  • Experiência em gerenciadores de casos de teste.
  • Noções de programação/scripts para testar endpoints e realizar consultas em banco de dados.
  • Atributos ou atitudes específicas: Perfil proativo e curioso, sempre buscando antecipar falhas.
  • Boa comunicação para reportar bugs e orientar o time sobre criticidade.
  • Capacidade analítica para desenhar cenários eficazes e identificar edge cases.
  • Capricho na construção de documentação e materiais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência como analista de integrações ou atuação como Partner Engineer.
  • Conhecimento em roteirização de vídeos tutoriais.
  • Inglês avançado.

Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Trabalho 100% remoto.
  • Cultura de confiança, focada em resultados e com muito desafio e aprendizado.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off per year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Opportunities for personal and career growth with a growth mindset and investment in employee development.
  • CULTURE: A supportive, diverse, and ambitious global team; information available on our careers page.

Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa Cultura

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

  • Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.
  • Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.
  • Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.
  • The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Sênior Data Engineer

Estamos buscando pessoas engenheiras de dados com background e expertise na área, criativas, com energia, comprometidas, que saiba trabalhar bem em equipe, com foco de resolver o problema do cliente com muita qualidade e que queiram encarar conosco o desafio de fazer parte do time de tecnologia responsável pelo Crédito da Stone.

Nosso produto está na rua a todo vapor e queremos escalar ainda mais nosso produto ampliando a sua capacidade, aproveitando todo seu potencial e melhorar ainda mais os pilares técnicos e de eficiência. Nosso produto tem interação com diversas fontes de dados importantes e cruciais para a vida do ciclo de crédito, sejam nossos dados internos cadastrais e transacionais, dados de provedores externos sobre endividamento, restritivo, rede de relacionamento, garantias e os diversos dados internos da companhia. Integrar, transformar e disponibilizar esses dados não é uma tarefa fácil e com todo volume que temos o desafio se torna ainda maior. Pra continuar no caminho certo, precisamos das melhores pessoas, que saibam contribuir bem em time e trabalhar sem ego, afinal, só como um time temos grandes resultados!

Importante lembrar que o nosso desafio requer pessoas com pensamentos de processar dados, construindo processos de qualidade e dispostas a construir sistemas altamente escaláveis e resilientes.

Junto Ao Time, Você Será Responsável Por

  • Você irá compor um time de alta performance com o foco em: projetar, desenvolver, testar, implantar, manter e melhorar o processos de engenharia de dados com foco em solucionar problemas reais dos nossos clientes;
  • Auxiliar na construção de soluções com visão de longo prazo e muita qualidade;
  • Você será um defensor das boas práticas, nossos acordos e processos, revisões, testes e documentações dentro do seu time e influenciar esta cultura o máximo possível;
  • É esperado de você extrema facilidade de trabalho em equipe, muita franqueza e transparência para que no dia-a-dia possa ter ótimo relacionamento com o time e transmitir conhecimento;
  • Aqui todos possuem a mente aberta para trabalhar com qualquer tecnologia, muita vontade de aprender e entregar resultado, além de ser apaixonado por tecnologia e sistemas de alta performance;

O Que Esperamos De Você

  • Experiência em linguagem de desenvolvimento para ferramentas e rotinas de Data Engineering (Python, Java, Scala ou outras);
  • Processo de Data Quality / qualidade e testes para Engenharia de Dados;
  • Conhecimentos sobre BigQuery / Datalake;
  • Conhecimentos de processamento com Databricks / ferramentas de Big Data;
  • Experiência com operação de serviços na nuvem;

O Que Aumenta As Suas Chances

  • Conhecimentos de negócio de Crédito e Risco;
  • Conhecimento de provedores de dados como SCR, Boa Vista (BVS), Serasa etc;
  • Experiência em projetos voltados para a área financeira;
  • Experiência com aplicações críticas e de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias em geral é sempre um diferencial;

Nossos Benefícios

Etapas Do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Avaliação Técnica: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills! Geralmente essa avaliação é composta por dois papos ou um papo mais o desafio, com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências técnicas específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.
  • E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

Sobre a Allintra

Sobre a Allintra
A Allintra é uma startup brasileira de tecnologia com uma missão ambiciosa: transformar a forma como o trading de criptoativos é feito no Brasil. Estamos construindo uma plataforma de investimento de nível profissional, inteligente e colaborativa — conectando traders experientes a investidores em um ecossistema seguro, transparente e poderoso.

Estamos no momento mais decisivo da nossa jornada : o lançamento do Beta Test privado da plataforma. E para garantir que essa fase seja inesquecível para nossos primeiros 500 usuários, buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por experiência do cliente, tecnologia e construção de comunidade.

Sua missão

Você será a ponte entre nossos usuários e o time Allintra. Vai garantir que os traders se sintam ouvidos, valorizados e empoderados, transformando seus feedbacks em decisões estratégicas de produto. Durante o lançamento, será responsável por cultivar uma comunidade ativa, acompanhar a jornada dos primeiros usuários e traduzir suas experiências em insights acionáveis.

Você irá atuar diretamente na construção da jornada dos usuários reais, desenvolvendo processos de engajamento, estruturando canais de escuta e ajudando a consolidar uma cultura de produto centrada no cliente. Mais do que suporte, buscamos o protagonista na criação de experiências que encantem, envolvam e gerem valor real.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na estruturação da experiência contínua dos usuários da plataforma, garantindo um atendimento encantador e proativo.
  • Ser o ponto focal de relacionamento com os usuários e clientes do Allintra, garantindo engajamento, acolhimento e suporte proativo.
  • Manter a escuta ativa da comunidade de usuários, identificando comportamentos, desafios e oportunidades de evolução de produto.
  • Acompanhar a jornada de uso e mapear pontos de atrito ou oportunidades de encantamento dos usuários.

  • Conduzir réguas de comunicação (convites, atualizações, avisos de melhorias), reforçando o vínculo dos usuários com a evolução da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver processos de CX escaláveis, desde fluxos de boas-vindas até estratégias de encantamento, retenção e ativação de usuários reais.
  • Apoiar a implementação de métricas de experiência (NPS, CSAT, churn reasons) e propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks reais.
  • Participar da construção de estratégias de fidelização contínua dos clientes, sempre colocando a experiência no centro das decisões.
  • Identificar usuários influentes para transformá-los em promotores da marca — os primeiros “Allintra Pioneers”.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência comprovada em Customer Experience, Customer Success ou Relacionamento com clientes B2C
  • Excelente capacidade em Comunicação e Escuta com usuários (Traders e Investidores)
  • Curiosidade, resiliência e agilidade para entender a fundo as dores dos usuários e estruturar feedbacks com lógica
  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas de CRM (RD Station CRM, Zendesk, Hubspot, etc)
  • Capacidade de coletar, interpretar e usar dados de feedback para tomar decisões informadas
  • Paixão por tecnologia, produto digital e experiência do usuário
  • Proatividade, autonomia e vontade de construir em um ambiente de startup em constante evolução
  • Experiência com ferramentas de comunidade (Discord, Telegram, Reddit), formulários (Typeform, Google Forms) e outras ferramentas importantes como CX/CS

Diferenciais que brilham

  • Conhecimento sobre o universo e termos do mercado de criptoativos e trading. (Saber o que é um stop-loss, fork, HOLDers ou altcoin te coloca à frente.)
  • Experiência anterior em CX ou CS atendendo B2C no mercado de criptoativos ou financeiro

O que oferecemos

  • Contato direto com traders experientes, feedbacks reais e decisões com impacto direto no produto
  • Ambiente 100% remoto, colaborativo, horizontal e com alta autonomia

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Job description

Direct Response Copywriter — Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team. You will be responsible for ideation, scripting, planning, and managing the entire creative process with a focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing and bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Localization Quality Assurance Specialist role at Kraken. The Localization Team at Kraken is looking for a Localization Quality Assurance Specialist to improve localization process automations, localization testing and quality assurance workflows, as well as support the internationalization of our products and growing localization needs. You’ll work alongside our localization project managers and cross-functional technical, data and product-focused stakeholders (engineers, product managers, designers), whose mission is to consistently deliver the best experience to our international clients. As a LQA Specialist, you will own our localization automation and testing processes, and also drive continuous improvement initiatives of our localization workflows to drive localization impact on key business metrics.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure linguistic and functional quality for our global products and identify continuous improvement opportunities for country/market customizations.
  • Measure and report on quality of MT and AI engines, as well as MTPE workflows.
  • Improve Linguistic QA (LQA) process, drive localization testing with our vendors and internal teams for applications and features.
  • Lead end to end testing, bug triaging, Jira ticket assignment, reporting functional and linguistic bugs, validate bug fixes, implementation and regression testing.
  • Identify areas for LQA process improvements, define localization requirements for test automation and track status of test automation and manage the backlog of test automation implementation.
  • Design and run efficient localization QA practices for multiple products and content types (UI, help center, website, legal, marketing and multimedia).
  • Track and report localization impact on business metrics in key geos and growth initiatives.
  • Interact with Localization Project Managers to scope out and facilitate localization quality and improvements across languages.
  • Define and track success metrics for localization quality and efficiency.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of quality assurance experience in Localization Operations, Localization Program Management, International Product Management, or equivalent roles managing complex software localization cycle from end to end.
  • Experience in multilingual UI/UX testing across multiple platforms with in-depth knowledge of MQM and other methodologies.
  • Strong understanding of mobile and web applications localization and internationalization development lifecycle (Unicode and CLDR; CI/CD; agile software development; LQA processes; test automation; continuous improvement and best practices).
  • Understanding of testing automation tools or frameworks like Selenium, LambdaTest, Cypress.
  • Ability to implement Jira, Slack and other automations to streamline the bug reporting, triage, and resolution process.
  • Excellent analytical skills and usage of data-driven tools (e.g., Tableau, Snowflake, Mixpanel, Google Analytics).
  • High proficiency in one or more Project Management tools, preferably tools used in Agile development (JIRA, Airtable, Coda, etc.) as well as Confluence.
  • Degree or equivalent training/experience in Localization, Engineering, Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, or related technical field.
  • This is a remote role, open globally, and requires flexibility in working hours.

Nice to have

  • Native-level proficiency in one or more of the following languages is a plus: Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Chinese.

Kraken is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed requirement, as long as you’re passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de modelagem de dados como dbt;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de qualidade de dados como Great Expectations;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de data visualization como PowerBI, Metabase, Tableau, etc.

Somos a primeira startup de Gestão por Assinatura do Brasil e queremos ser o braço direito de cada empreendedor. Nós atuamos assumindo serviços de Backoffice Financeiro, Contábil, Jurídico, entre outros, para que os empreendedores possam focar no que é mais importante para o seu negócio.

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Boise, ID; Spokane, WA

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.

  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
